We use five different metrics, including human evaluation, to measure the generation performance of each method ... • PPL reflects the average density of samples ... • Rev-PPL is a good indicator ... • EMD-l is the earth mover distance between sentence lengths ... • EMD-f is the earth mover distance between word frequencies ...

We use the following metrics. • PPL reflects the average density of samples from test set in a generative model. • Rev-PPL is a good indicator for both sample quality and diversity, • EMD-l is the earth mover distance between sentence lengths of real and generated data. • EMD-f is the earth mover distance between word frequencies of real and generated data.
